title: Witness hears a buzzing like machine bees from a craft

tellings.quote: Yeah, we heard a sound in that in that direction. It was sort of like a buzzing noise.

plain: In a podcast episode hosted by Jesse Michels, an unnamed witness describes hearing a sound from the direction of a craft. They say it was a buzzing noise, a little like mechanical bees. No time or place is given, but the detail is offered as a sign that the craft was a real, physical machine.
